method: Actual routes, validation, session authentication and DatabaseStorage against an isolated PostgreSQL database; Calendar replaced by a no-network fixture.

results.name: Staff data requires an authenticated session
Normal staff login with fixture credentials
Invalid staff player count is rejected
Staff sessions ending after 22h are rejected
Staff creation permits omitted email and phone
An overlapping same-bay booking is rejected
The same hour in a different bay is permitted
Staff can update an isolated reservation
Staff deletion removes the isolated database record
Client booking requires a valid email
Public availability is accessible without staff sign-in
Confirmed privacy finding: unauthenticated reservations endpoint returns full sample contact data

observations.finding: Invalid public booking payload is rejected, but its error response is not the expected JSON 400.
